about: Ready-made 8-card decks for the Deck Builder. Only cards CRbot simulates today. The scripted AI only pushes with building-targeting win conditions (Hog Rider), so Hog decks are the strongest AI opponents.

decks.name: Hog 2.6 Cycle
decks.tip: The classic. Out-cycle their answer to Hog Rider and chip every push.

decks.name: CRbot Starter
decks.tip: Easy to learn: Knight tanks, Musketeer and Archers back it up, Hog Rider wins the game.

decks.name: Hog Rocket Cycle
decks.tip: Defend cheaply, Rocket the tower when the game gets close.

decks.name: Hog Valkyrie
decks.tip: Valkyrie clears swarms, then follow her across the bridge with Hog.

decks.name: Hog Mini P.E.K.K.A
decks.tip: Mini P.E.K.K.A shreds tanks; counter-push with Hog in the same lane.

decks.name: Hog Tornado Valk
decks.tip: Tornado pulls troops into Valkyrie's spin. Strong on defence.

decks.name: Hog Royal Ghost
decks.tip: Pressure both lanes: Ghost on one side, Hog on the other.

decks.name: Hog Spirits 2.0
decks.tip: Lowest average in the list. Hog Rider comes back every 8 seconds.

decks.name: Hog Skeleton Army
decks.tip: Skeleton Army stops big single-target troops cold.

decks.name: Hog Dart Goblin
decks.tip: Dart Goblin outranges most defenders; keep him behind Valkyrie.

decks.name: Hog Barbarian Barrel
decks.tip: Barbarian Barrel clears the bridge and leaves a Barbarian for the counter-push.

decks.name: Hog Evo Knight Control
decks.tip: Defend with Evo Knight and Tornado, then punish with Hog.

decks.name: Hog Air Support
decks.tip: Plenty of anti-air; Minions also defend ground pushes.

decks.name: Hog Heavy Spells
decks.tip: Three spells for chip damage. Close games are won with Rocket.

decks.name: Hog Electro Zap
decks.tip: Electro Spirit and Zap reset and stun; time them with your Hog.

decks.name: Hog Knight Archers
decks.tip: Cheap, solid defenders. Good deck to practise elixir counting.

decks.name: Hog Double Spirit Valk
decks.tip: Spirits make cheap trades; Valkyrie anchors the defence.

decks.name: Hog Tornado Cannon
decks.tip: Tornado drags troops onto Cannon: very cheap defence.

decks.name: Hog Mini P.E.K.K.A Rush
decks.tip: Fast pressure: drop Hog or Mini P.E.K.K.A at the bridge when they run low.

decks.name: Hog Royal Ghost Rocket
decks.tip: Split pressure, then Rocket the weaker tower to finish.

decks.name: Hog Skeleton Knight
decks.tip: Many units: their single spell can't answer everything.

decks.name: Hog Valk Mini P.E.K.K.A
decks.tip: Two strong melee defenders; turn every defence into a push.

decks.name: Rocket Cycle
decks.tip: No Hog: defend everything and Rocket the tower again and again.

decks.name: Royal Ghost Bait
decks.tip: Bait out their small spell, then the swarm cards connect.

decks.name: Valkyrie Bridge Spam
decks.tip: Keep dropping troops at the bridge and never give them time to build up.

decks.name: Mini P.E.K.K.A Control
decks.tip: Defend first; every big defence becomes a Mini P.E.K.K.A counter-push.

decks.name: Evo Knight Beatdown
decks.tip: Evo Knight tanks in front of the whole army. Build one big push.

decks.name: Swarm Party
decks.tip: No spells at all: practise placement and swarm defence.

decks.name: Spell Turtle
decks.tip: Turtle up behind Cannon and win with spells. Very slow and patient.

decks.name: Ghost Tornado Control
decks.tip: Royal Ghost sneaks in while Tornado and Valkyrie hold the defence.
